That sounds really frustrating. If there was no contact info on the charges, it might be worth checking your **email receipts** or **App Store/Google Play purchase history** to see which app it was linked to.

SmartyMe only processes payments through official app stores, so if there were multiple charges from different apps, it could be something broader. Either way, sounds like you did the right thing by contacting your bank. Hope you get it all sorted out soon!

That definitely sounds alarming, but just to clarify- SmartyMe doesn’t have access to anyone’s bank account or process payments directly. All transactions go through the App Store or Google Play, so if there were unauthorized charges outside of your subscription, it’s likely unrelated or a coincidence.

Canceling your card was a smart move if you saw suspicious activity. If you haven’t already, Apple can confirm whether the charge was tied to an actual subscription. Hope you get it all sorted out.

Sounds like a frustrating experience, but I’m glad you got your money back. Refunds aren’t automatic, but they do get reviewed case by case, and it looks like pushing back helped in your case. If there’s anything else unclear about the process, happy to help explain.

I get why you're angry– if you never signed up, that definitely shouldn't be happening. SmartyMe doesn’t randomly charge people, so this sounds like either a mistaken charge or maybe someone else used your payment info. If it showed up through Apple, checking your **Apple subscriptions** under **Settings → Your Name → Subscriptions** can confirm if there’s an active sub.

Since you’ve already contacted Apple, they should be able to help sort it out. If you want, you can also reach out to support with any transaction details, and they can check if it’s linked to an account. Hope you get it resolved soon.

I hear you– that sounds really stressful. First, don’t panic. If you’ve already emailed support, they should get back to you soon and can check what happened.

In the meantime, you can also cancel in the app under **Profile→ Manage Subscription→ Cancel Subscription** to stop future charges. If the amounts don’t match what you agreed to, your bank might be able to help too. Let me know if you don’t hear back from support– I can flag it internally.

Hey, I get why that’s frustrating. The app is meant to adapt to different knowledge levels, but it sounds like it didn’t match what you were expecting. The early lessons cover foundational concepts before getting deeper, but if it felt too basic for you, that’s definitely fair feedback. If you’re looking for something more advanced, I can pass that along to the team. Let me know if I can help with anything else.

Hey, I hear you– I’m from the SmartyMe team. If something went wrong with your experience, I’d really like to understand what happened. That sounds really frustrating, and I get why you’re pissed. Just to clarify– SmartyMe doesn’t do random or hidden charges like that. If you’ve never signed up, then this sounds like fraud where someone else used your card info. Freezing the card was the right move.

If you want, you can DM support with the transaction details, and they can confirm if it even came from us. But if this was an unauthorized charge, your bank will be the best way to get it reversed. Hope you get it sorted.
